pins.definition: The front part of the head from the forehead to the chin, or the expression on it.
The front part of a person's head, where the eyes, nose, and mouth are, or the expression shown on it.
The front part of the human head containing the eyes, nose, and mouth.

situation: An artist at an easel carefully sketching the front of a human head from a plaster cast.
subject: the front of the head containing the eyes, nose, and mouth
brief: A detailed 19th-century scientific plate shows the human face isolated against aged cream paper, detailing the precise proportions of the eyes, nose, and mouth. Delicate fine-line ink and soft watercolor shading define the brow, cheekbones, and jawline without background distractions.
